author: Brent Tyler
reason: Brent explicitly confirmed December 1, 15 and 20 date-to-event associations. Separate transcription corrections remain authoritative.

associations.event: Pape becomes XO; West S-1; Marcum Echo CO; Hickethier Foxtrot CO
associations.originalReading:
1 DECEMBER 1965                   Major T. E. BULGER was relieved as Executive Officer
                                  by Major R. A. PAPE.  Major T. E. BULGER was trans-
                                  ferred out of the Battalion.  First Lieutenant T.
                                  BOYD was relieved as S-1 by First Lieutenant D. R.
                                  WEST.  First Lieutenant T. R. MINOR was relieved as
                                  CO, "E" Co, by First Lieutenant D. E. MARCUM.  First
                                  Lieutenant T. R. MINOR was transferred out of the
                                  Battalion.  First Lieutenant G. S. BURGETT was re-
                                  lieved as CO, "F" Co, by Captain R. A. HICKETHIER.

associations.event: Uskurait becomes CO; Waller XO; Pape S-3
associations.originalReading:
20 DECEMBER 1965                  Major L. W. T. WALLER, II, was relieved as Commanding
                                  Officer by Lieutenant Colonel R. H. USKURAIT.
                                  Major L. W. T. WALLER, II, became the Executive Of-
                                  ficer.  Major R. A. PAPE became the S-3.
